# lx05-v1 opt-in owner wire

C-LIGHT:1 envelopes, counters, framing, leases, command correlation/retry cache,
scopes, page budgets and expected-revision rules remain LX03/04. Only explicit
`lux-service ... --analysis ABSOLUTE_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_SOCKET` enables this schema.
Snapshot inventory advertises `wire_schema:lx05-v1`, `analysis` and `applied_auto`.
Legacy listeners and old corpora retain their prior schemas/bytes/behavior.

Read-only kind `analysis_status`, body `{}`, all writer/lease/request/revision
fields null, returns the ordinary correlated C-LIGHT response envelope with
kind `analysis_status`, body `{wire_schema:"lx05-v1",analysis:...}`. It validates
show/module/epoch/version and never grants. Snapshot includes that same status.

Under the existing explicit lighting-control writer lease, expected revision and
strictly increasing request ID, kind command body is `{scope:"lighting-control",
command:ACTION}`. New actions:

```json
{"action":"analysis_calibrate","phase":"start"}
{"action":"analysis_calibrate","phase":"finish"}
{"action":"mode","mode":"auto"}
{"action":"analysis_grant","fixtures":["fixture-11"],"cap":500,"ttl_ms":1000}
```

Calibration start needs a freshly attached source/window; finish needs50 contiguous
480-frame windows, all sources observed, <=10s. Analyzer settles500ms. Grants need
fresh ready confidence1000, explicit Auto mode,1..32 unique valid intensity fixtures,
cap0..1000, ttl10..2000ms multiple10. Cap below retained AUTO contribution refuses
atomically; human values outside cap are untouched. Grant itself changes no value.
Bindings: writer/lease, issue revision, patch revision, accepted analysis generation
(includes attachment/calibration); grant state is transient. No implicit renew/rearm.

Analysis status fields: `analysis_version:"lux.analysis.v1"`,
`state:absent|invalid|calibrating|settling|ready|stale`, nullable bounded `reason`,
`source_identity` (strict accepted C-ANALYSIS descriptor or null), `source_epoch`,
`map_revision`, `calibration_revision`, ordered `sources`,
`source_window_range:{first_frame,end_frame_exclusive}` or null (canonical counters),
`source_age_ms` integer/null measured from oldest acquisition, canonical `losses`,
`generation`, nullable `calibration_generation`, integer `calibration_windows`,
`confidence`0..1000, `rms_millionths` four integers/null, `energy_millionths` integer/null,
`beat/downbeat/harmony` null, nullable intensity `proposal`, `grant` object/null,
`automatic_layer:{values:[{fixture,intensity,source,held_reason}]}`, `held_reason` null/string.
Absent/invalid input reports confidence0; unavailable RMS/energy are null.
RMS/activity/energy are existing isolated-source measures, not musical beat certainty.

Intensity snapshots add optional `auto` integer, omitted when absent. Contributor
and winner Source uses existing externally tagged serde enum:
`{"auto":"mode-entry-continuity"}`, `{"auto":"analysis-active"}` or
`{"auto":"analysis-held"}`. Per-fixture layer metadata retains reason and value.
Priority: programmer > existing reviewed release > human Hold > AUTO > ordinary
playback > default. AUTO never adds color/position/strobe. Each owner10ms tick may
apply one step<=20units toward existing show-policy scene intensity, bounded by cap;
no catchup. Release overlap freezes its underlying AUTO destination until end.
Loss/age/identity/calibration/lease/patch/mode/expiry revokes before next step,
retaining current AUTO contribution. Restart uses existing disarmed intended-look
recovery into Hold; no analysis grant or transient resumes. Manual/Assist retain
existing continuity behavior; ASSIST only displays proposal.

`commands.json` is generated by the actual owner Service/Authority test, not a
surface simulator. It exercises absent status, mode-entry AUTO, unready grant
refusal and Assist continuity. Reproduce through the shared build helper with
`LUX_GENERATE_LX05_CORPUS=1 ... cargo +1.97.1 test --locked -j1 --test analysis_authority exact_lx05_owner_wire_corpus`.
Active/loss/manual real-process evidence is produced by `scripts/check-lux-analysis.py`
with explicit accepted provider and Lux release paths. Evidence stays private.
Null output, disarmed physicalunknown, submitted/observed null throughout.

Snapshot-budget safety: normal opt-in state/commands use at most15 encoded pages;
the16th page is reserved for bounded loss/freeze diagnostics and retained AUTO
provenance. Every analysis tick validates a complete private candidate inventory
before committing. Capacity refusal keeps prior readable values and revokes the
grant with `snapshot_capacity`. A post-DSP and post-encoding acquisition-clock check
also prevents processing delay from committing a newly stale step. Emergency
state remains readable; subsequent edits must fit the normal15-page budget.

Each automatic-layer value also carries nullable `provenance`: the actual
analysis_version, accepted source_identity, source_window_range,
calibration_generation and confidence used for that contribution. It remains
with analysis-held values across disconnect/reattach; new feature status cannot
silently relabel an old retained contribution. `features.json` is actual owner
output for qualified exact E09 PCM, active AUTO, aged loss and a real manual
command/reply under an injected acquisition clock. The normal unit test compares
it exactly; it contains no provider algorithms or physical measurements.

## Independent release capability

`lx05-v1` analysis is independent of the existing timed-release and durable modes.
`lux-service --analysis PATH` alone advertises analysis without `release` or
`checkpoint`. `--timed` adds the existing validated release capability; `--durable`
includes timed release and adds checkpoint capability. These two mode flags are
alternatives: `--durable` already enables timing.

For LX05, consumers validate `release` strictly when present and keep static
operation restrictions when it is absent. A schema name alone never enables a
timed preview. `checkpoint` is available only when its existing durable capability
is advertised and validated. Legacy LX03/LX04 required fields are unchanged.
`untimed-absent.json` is an actual accepted producer inventory with analysis enabled,
a missing source and neither optional mode; no private paths or physical state
are included. The original command/feature corpus remains byte-identical.
